feedback: Written before this candidate races. Race 7 (entityR2B, 636.91) is the best result: five 16 mm sensors at y = 0.06 with kp 3.2, kd 0.6 and base_speed 0.95. Oval finished 20/20 and s-bend 16/20, but slalom still finished 0/20 with 1.2 line-loss events and max_error at the limit. Race 3 (235.88) showed that widening to 0.04 m did not fix slalom, and race 6 (389.47) showed that seven-sensor density did not either (line loss 1.25). So reach, spread and density are ruled out, and gain tuning in race 7 did not fix it. That makes the platform the limiter, which is why I took your body_length test. Your change is clean because the controller is unchanged. Once the race reports: if slalom line loss falls below 1, keep body_length 0.12. If slalom line loss is unchanged or worse, yaw inertia is not the limiter, and the next step is wheel_track 0.10 with a controller rescale. Do not change mass in the same step.
requested_changes: Keep the five 16 mm sensors at x = -0.03 to +0.03 and y = 0.06 with body_length 0.12 m, so the body change is tested alone against race 7.

If slalom line loss is still 1 or more with max_error at 0.06, try wheel_track 0.10 (the low end) with kp rescaled to about 2.7, since the smaller track raises yaw gain by about 1.2 times for the same command.
If oval steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 with the same gains, adjust kd (about +0.1 to +0.2) before any further geometry change.
